SubSideExit.name: Message box: close, draw text, animate
summary: Second half of the in-level message box routine (entry CODE_05B10C is in the previous chunk, called from InLevelGameMode while [$1426] != 0).
[$1B88] = state (0 opening, 1 closing), [$1B89] = box size 0-$50 in steps of 4. Opening: at size $4C builds the text, at $50 waits for a button.
Text: looks up the message for level [$13BF] and message number [$1426], writes 8 rows of 18 tiles to the stripe image buffer for BG3.
Switch palace messages ([$13D2] != 0) also draw the switch icons in OAM. The box itself is a window HDMA table (channel 7) growing from the center.
Closing: at size $50 hides the icons and blanks the text via stripe image 9; at size 0 resets the window registers.
$05B160 (entry from the intro skip) clears [$0109], sets [$0DD5] = 0 and the game mode to $0B.

s05B29B.name: Table: switch icon OAM tiles
summary: 4 switches x (left icon 4 words + right icon 4 words) of tile number, properties for CODE_05B2EB.

s05B2DB.name: Table: switch icon OAM positions
summary: X,Y byte pairs for the 8 sprites of the left and right switch icons.

s05B2EB.name: Switch icon sprites and coin counter
summary: $05B2EB: draws the 8 OAM entries (sprites 0-7) of the switch palace message icons. Parameters: X = switch number 0-3.
$05B31B: hides those 8 sprites (Y = $F0).
$05B329 (unused entry) / $05B330: adds A coins to [$13CC] and subtracts them from [$0DC0] (floor 0). Called via JSL from bank 00.
$05B34A: adds one coin to [$13CC], plays the coin sound and decrements [$0DC0] if non-zero. Called via JSL from many banks.

s05B363.name: Unused. Test overworld level-cleared flag
summary: Parameters: Y = bit number. Returns: A = bit of [$1F02 + Y/8] (non-zero if set).

s05B375.name: Stripe image: title screen
summary: VRAM stripe image for the title screen, continued in the 6 bytes at B5L3TMAP1 (ends with $FF). ImagePointers index $03.

B5L3TMAP1.name: Stripe images and tile animation tables
summary: $05B6F8: last tiles and end marker of the title screen image.

$05B6FE: two file select images (the second at $05B7C9 is copied to the RAM stripe buffer by CODE_009D38), then the images for 1 PLAYER / 2 PLAYER GAME ($05B872), CONTINUE AND SAVE ($05B8C7) and CONTINUE / END ($05B91C).
$05B93B: tile animation tables for CODE_05BB39: VRAM destinations per frame ([$14] AND 7), slot type per (frame*3 + slot), switch timer selector, tileset offsets.

AnimatedTileData.name: Animated tile data and frame update
summary: Table: 8 bytes per animation row = four 16-bit source addresses (bank $7E, 128 bytes each) for the 4 frames, picked by ([$14] AND $18) / 4.
$05BB39 (CODE_05BB39): once per frame fills the NMI's tile animation DMA variables: [$0D7C]/[$0D7E]/[$0D80] VRAM destinations and [$0D76]/[$0D78]/[$0D7A] sources for the 3 slots of this frame.
Row selection per slot: type 0 fixed; type 1 +$26 while the blue P, silver P or ON/OFF timer ([$14AD+X]) is non-zero; type 2 + tileset offset ([$1931]).

s05BC00.name: Run scroll routines, compute scroll deltas
summary: $05BC00: runs the layer 1 scroll routine ([$143E]) and the layer 2 scroll routine ([$143F]), then stores the per-frame scroll deltas of layer 1 in [$17BC]/[$17BD] and of layer 2 in [$17BE]/[$17BF]. Skips layer 3 handling while the message box is up.
$05BC4A: [$26]/[$28] = position of layer 2 (or layer 3 if [$1403] != 0) relative to layer 1. $05BC72: long-call wrapper.
$05BC76: layer 1 dispatch ([$1456] = 0): returns if sprites are locked or [$143E] = 0.

Ptrs05BC87.name: Pointer table: layer 1 scroll routines
summary: Indexed by [$143E]. Followed by $05BCA5, the layer 2 dispatch ([$1456] = 4, index [$143F], returns if sprites are locked or the index is 0).

Ptrs05BCB8.name: Pointer table: layer 2 scroll routines
summary: Indexed by [$143F]. Followed by $05BCD6: second pass over both layers (called from bank 02 after a scroll command is written to [$1440]).

Ptrs05BCF0.name: Pointer table: second-pass routines
summary: Indexed by [$143E]; $05BD0E dispatches the matching table for [$143F].
